outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle, then pulls the door outward and downward (frames 70–95, image and left_ego_image). The door is visibly open with the oven interior exposed by frame 95 and remains open through frame 120; wrist_image also shows the lowered door alongside the gripper. No failed acquisition, unwanted object displacement, or other harmful side effect is visibly established.
